sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.label: Modbus RS232/RS485

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.n.description: Changes the name of the Modbus module (maximum 16 characters).

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.b.label: Baud rate
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.b.description: Sets the data transmission rate in bits per second. Options: 9600, 19200 (default), 38.4K, 57.6K, or 115.2K.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.m.label: Modbus mode
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.m.description: Sets the Modbus mode: RTU (default) or ASCII.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Data order
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.description: Sets byte order for floating point transmission: Little endian (default) or Big endian.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.p.label: Parity
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.p.description: Sets per-byte error checking for RS232/RS485: None (default), Even, or Odd.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.s.label: Stop bits
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.s.description: Sets the number of stop bits: 1 (default) or 2.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Diagnostics/Test
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.description: Diagnostics and test options for the Modbus RS232/RS485 module.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Network timing
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.description: Sets maximum response time values: Read timeout, Register write timeout, File write timeout, and File preparation timeout.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Modbus statistics
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.description: Shows the number of successful and failed Modbus requests.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Module information
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.description: Shows the software version, bootloader version and serial number of the Modbus module.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Reset
sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.description: Resets the Modbus settings to factory defaults.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.profinet.label: PROFINET
sc4500@3.90/outputs.profinet.description: Configure the optional PROFINET Industrial Ethernet module.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.profinet.telegram_pr.label: Telegram
sc4500@3.90/outputs.profinet.telegram_pr.description: Manages the Telegram data structure for PROFINET; selects devices and data tags.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.ethernet_ip.label: EtherNet/IP
sc4500@3.90/outputs.ethernet_ip.description: Configure the optional EtherNet/IP Industrial Ethernet module.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.ethernet_ip.telegram.label: Telegram
sc4500@3.90/outputs.ethernet_ip.telegram.description: Manages the Telegram data structure for EtherNet/IP; selects devices and data tags.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.hold_outputs.label: Hold outputs
sc4500@3.90/outputs.hold_outputs.description: Set the output mode of analog outputs to Hold or Transfer, or release them.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.hold_outputs.set_out.label: Set outputs on hold
sc4500@3.90/outputs.hold_outputs.set_out.description: Sets the analog outputs on hold for selected channels so displayed measurements do not change.

sc4500@3.90/outputs.hold_outputs.release.label: Release all outputs
sc4500@3.90/outputs.hold_outputs.release.description: Releases all analog outputs from hold.

sc4500@3.90/information.label: Information

sc4500@3.90/information.controller_detai.label: Controller details
sc4500@3.90/information.controller_detai.description: Shows the controller serial number, installed software package, user-defined facility and location.

sc4500@3.90/information.sc_devices_detai.label: SC devices details
sc4500@3.90/information.sc_devices_detai.description: Shows data for connected devices including device type, serial number, firmware and Claros status.

sc4500@3.90/information.software_details.label: Software details

sc4500@3.90/information.connectivity_sta.label: Connectivity status

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.label: Settings
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.description: Enter identification information for the sensor and change options for data handling and storage.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.name.label: Name
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.name.description: Changes the name for the device at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 16 characters.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.measureme.label: Measurement Type
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.measureme.description: Changes the measured parameter to Conductivity (default), Concentration, TDS or Salinity; changing the parameter resets all other settings to defaults.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.conductiv.label: Conductivity Unit
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.conductiv.description: Changes the conductivity units to µS/cm (default), mS/cm or S/cm; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity, Concentration or Salinity.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.cell_cons.label: Cell Constant Parameters
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.cell_cons.description: Changes the cell constant to the actual certified K value from the label on the sensor cable; default: 4.70; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity or Salinity.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.concentra.label: Concentration Measurement
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.concentra.description: Sets the type of concentration table to use — Built-in (default) or User defined; only available when Measurement Type is set to Concentration.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.tds.label: TDS (Total Dissolved Solids)
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.tds.description: Sets the factor used to convert conductivity to TDS — NaCl (default) or User defined; only available when Measurement Type is set to TDS.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.temperatu.label: Temperature
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.temperatu.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.t_compens.label: T-compensation
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.t_compens.description: Adds a temperature-dependent correction to the measured value — None, Linear (default: 2.0%/°C, 25 °C), Natural water, or Temperature compensation table.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.data_logg.label: Data Logger Interval
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.data_logg.description: Sets the time interval for sensor and temperature measurement storage in the data log — Disabled (default), 5, 10, 15, 30 seconds, 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 minutes or 1, 2, 6, 12 hours.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.alternati.label: Alternating Current Frequency
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.alternati.description: Selects the power line frequency for best noise rejection — 50 or 60 Hz (default).

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.filter.label: Filter
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.filter.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 60 seconds, default 0) to calculate a rolling average and increase signal stability.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.temperatu.label: Temperature Element
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.temperatu.description: Sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT1000 (default) or Manual.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.last_cali.label: Last Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.last_cali.description: Sets a reminder for the next calibration (default: 60 days); a reminder shows on the display after the selected interval from the date of the last calibration.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.sensor_da.label: Sensor Days
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.sensor_da.description: Sets a reminder for sensor replacement (default: 365 days); a reminder shows on the display after the selected interval.

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.reset_set.label: Reset Setup
3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.reset_set.description: Sets the Settings menu to factory defaults and resets all counters; all device information is lost.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.label: Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.description: Calibration options for the inductive conductivity sensor connected to an sc digital gateway.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.zero_c.label: Zero Calibration (0-point Calibration)
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.zero_c.description: Defines the unique zero point of the conductivity sensor by holding the dry sensor in air; must be completed before calibrating with a reference solution for the first time.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.conduc.label: Conductivity Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.conduc.description: Calibrates conductivity using a reference solution or process sample with a secondary verification instrument; modifies calibration slope and/or offset.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.tds_ca.label: TDS Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.tds_ca.description: Calibrates the TDS measurement using a process sample with a secondary verification instrument.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.concen.label: Concentration Calibration
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.concen.description: Calibrates the concentration measurement using a process sample with a secondary verification instrument.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.temper.label: 1-Point Temperature Calibration (Temperature Adjustment)
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.temper.description: Calibrates the temperature measurement by entering the exact temperature of a reference water sample.

3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.reset_.label: Reset to Calibration Defaults (Reset Setup)
3700_cond_gateway@All/calibration.reset_.description: Resets the calibration to factory default settings; all sensor calibration information is lost.

3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.description: Shows current and historical information about the sensor.

3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.sensor.label: Sensor Information
3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.sensor.description: Shows the sensor model number, serial number, software version and driver version installed.

3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.calibr.label: Calibration History
3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.calibr.description: Shows the cell constant parameters, offset correction and date of the last calibration.

3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.counte.label: Sensor Days
3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.counte.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.counte.label: Reset
3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.counte.description: Resets the Sensor Days counter to zero; reset when the sensor is replaced.

3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.sensor.label: Sensor Signal
3700_cond_gateway@All/diagnostics.sensor.description: Shows the current measurement analog-to-digital converter counter; allows setting the sensor range (default: 6).

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Settings
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Enter identification information for the sensor and change options for data handling and storage.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Name
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the name for the device at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 16 characters.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Sensor S/N
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Lets the user enter the serial number of the sensor; limited to 16 characters.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Measurement Type
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the measured parameter to Conductivity (default), Concentration, TDS or Salinity; changing the parameter resets all other settings to defaults.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Format
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the number of decimal places shown on the measurement screen to Auto, X.XXX, XX.XX or XXX.X.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Conductivity Unit
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the conductivity units to Auto, µS/cm, mS/cm or S/cm; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity or Concentration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Temperature
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: T-compensation
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Adds a temperature-dependent correction to the measured value — None, Linear (default: 2.0%/°C, 25 °C), Natural water, or Temperature compensation table.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Concentration Measurement
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the type of concentration table to use — Built-in (default) or User compensation table; only available when Measurement Type is set to Concentration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: TDS (Total Dissolved Solids)
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the factor used to convert conductivity to TDS — NaCl (default) or Custom; only available when Measurement Type is set to TDS.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Temperature Element
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT100, PT1000 (default) or Manual.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Cell Constant Parameters
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Changes the cell constant to the actual certified K value from the label on the sensor cable; default: 4.70.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Filter
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 200 seconds, default 0) to calculate a rolling average and increase signal stability.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Data Logger Interval
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the time interval for sensor and temperature measurement storage in the data log — 5 or 30 seconds, or 1, 2, 5, 10, 15 (default), 30 or 60 minutes.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.label: Reset Settings to Default Values
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.setting.description: Sets the Settings menu to factory defaults and resets all counters; all device information is lost.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibration options for the inductive conductivity sensor connected to a conductivity module.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Calibration Options
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Sets calibration reminders and operator ID options; not applicable to sensors connected to an sc digital gateway.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Calibration Reminder
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Sets a reminder interval for the next calibration (default: Off); a reminder shows on the display after the selected interval from the date of the last calibration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Operator ID for Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Includes an operator ID with calibration data — Yes or No (default); the ID is entered during calibration.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Zero Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Defines the unique zero point of the conductivity sensor; must be completed before calibrating with a reference solution for the first time.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Conductivity Solution
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibrates the sensor by matching its reading to a reference solution of known conductivity value; modifies the calibration slope and/or offset.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Conductivity Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibrates the sensor using the process sample with a secondary verification instrument.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: 1-Point Temperature Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Calibrates the temperature measurement by entering the exact temperature of a reference water sample.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.label: Reset to Default Calibration Values
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.calibra.description: Resets the calibration to factory default settings; all sensor calibration information is lost.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Diagnostics
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows current and historical information about the sensor.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Module Information
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the version and serial number of the conductivity module.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Sensor Information
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the sensor name and the serial number entered by the user.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Last Calibration
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the number of days since the last calibration was completed.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Calibration History
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the calibration slope and date of previous calibrations.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Sensor Signals
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the current conductivity and temperature reading.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Sensor Days
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.label: Reset
3700_cond_module@All/device_menu.diagnos.description: Sets the Sensor Days counter to zero; reset when the sensor is replaced.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.label: Configure
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.description: Use the Configure menu to enter identification information and display options for the sensor and to change options for data handling and storage.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.ed.label: Edit Name
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.ed.description: Changes the name that corresponds to the sensor on the top of the measure screen; limited to 10 characters; default is the sensor serial number.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Select Parameters
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Customizes the options for sensor data handling and storage.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Chlorine Sensor Type
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Select the type of chlorine sensor used — Total CL2 or Free CL2.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Sensor Used
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Select whether a pH sensor is used — Yes or No.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Sensor Type
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: If a pH sensor is used, select the type — DIFF PH (pHD) or COMBO pH (pH combination).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Select Units
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the units for the sensor measurements — Auto ppb-ppm, Auto ug/L-mg/L, Fixed ppm, or Fixed mg/L.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Display Format
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the number of decimal places shown on the measure screen — X.XXX, XX.XX (default), XXX.X, or XXXX (Auto).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Select Range
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the measurement range — 0 to 10 ppm.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Filter
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets a time constant to increase signal stability; calculates the average value during a specified time — 0 (filtering disabled) to 60 seconds.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Log Setup
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the time interval for event and data logging for chlorine concentration and flow status — 10 s, 30 s, 1 min, 5 min, 15 min (default), or 60 min.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Cal Watch
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the pH measurement deviation values that activate alarms.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Error Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the pH measurement deviation that activates an error alarm — 1 (default) to 3 pH units.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: pH Warning Deviation
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Sets the pH measurement deviation that activates a warning alarm — 0.5 (default) to 1 pH unit.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.re.label: Reset Defaults
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.configure.re.description: Sets the configuration menu to the default settings; all sensor information is lost.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: 1 Point Sample
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Performs a 1-point calibration using either a zero calibration or a process concentration measurement.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Output Signal Mode
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets the output signal behavior during calibration — Active, Hold, or Transfer.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Electrical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Removes the offset produced by the gateway to set the zero-point electronically (no sample used).

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Chemical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Measures water with no chlorine to set the zero-point chemically.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Process Conc
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Measures the chlorine concentration of the process flow (grab sample analysis) and enters the measured value to set the calibration slope.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: 2 Point Sample
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Performs a 2-point calibration using a zero calibration and a process concentration measurement.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Output Signal Mode
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets the output signal behavior during calibration — Active, Hold, or Transfer.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Calibration Type
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Select the zero-point method — Electrical or Chemical.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Electrical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Removes the offset produced by the gateway for the zero-point, then measures the process sample to calculate slope.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Chemical
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Measures water with no chlorine for the zero-point, then measures the process sample to calculate slope.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Reset Defaults
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Replaces the user calibration settings with the default calibration settings.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Cal Options
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets calibration reminder, auto stabilization, and operator ID options.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Auto Stab
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Enables automatic acceptance of the measurement signal when stable, advancing the calibration automatically — On or Off (default); stabilization range 25 to 75 ppb.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Cal Reminder
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Sets a reminder for the next calibration in days, months, or years.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.label: Operator ID on Cal
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.calibrate.ch.description: Includes an operator ID with calibration data — Yes or No (default); the ID is entered during calibration.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.label: Diag/Test
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.description: The diagnostic and test menu shows current and historical information about the chlorine analyzer.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ga.label: Gateway Info
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ga.description: Shows the firmware version, driver version, serial number, and boot version for the controller and the types of sensors connected.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.label: Cal Days
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.description: Shows the number of days since the sensor was last calibrated.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.label: Cal History
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.description: Shows a list of the times when the sensor was calibrated; push ENTER to scroll through entries and view a summary of calibration data.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.label: Reset Cal History
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.description: Resets the sensor calibration history; requires passcode.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.si.label: Signals
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.si.description: Shows the sensor measurement signal value in mV.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.se.label: Sensor Days
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.se.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.label: Reset Sensors
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.rs.description: Resets the sensor days and calibration days to default; requires passcode.

cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.label: Calibration
cl10sc@unknown/sensor_setup.diag_test.ca.description: Shows the slope and offset values for chlorine and pH (if pH sensor is used), and the temperature offset (if pH sensor is used).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings.label: Settings
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings.description: Configure the sensor for measurements, cleaning reminders, data handling and storage.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Name
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Changes the name that corresponds to the sensor on the measurement screen; limited to 16 characters.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Unit
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the units for temperature, measurement, and altitude/pressure.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Temperature
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Measurement
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the measurement units to mg/L, ppm (default) or %.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Altitude/Pressure
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the units for atmospheric pressure display to altitude (m or ft) or pressure (mmHg or torr).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Salinity
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the salinity correction value from 0.00 (default) to 250.00 parts per thousand (‰).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Signal Average
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets a time constant (0–999 seconds, default 60 s) to calculate a rolling average and increase signal stability.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Cleaning Interval
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the interval in days for the cleaning reminder (default: 0 days); set to 0 to disable.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Reset Cleaning Interval
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Resets the Days Remaining to Clean counter back to the Cleaning Interval value.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Data Logger Interval
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Sets the time interval for data storage in the data log (30 s, 1, 2, 5, 10, 15 [default], 30, or 60 minutes).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..label: Reset
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.settings..description: Resets all sensor settings back to factory defaults; does not change calibration slope or offset.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Calibration options for the LDO sc Model 2 sensor.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Air Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Recommended one-point calibration method using water-saturated air that modifies the calibration slope.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Calibration by comparison with a hand-held DO meter that modifies the calibration offset.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.label: Reset Calibration
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.calibrati.description: Resets the calibration gain (slope) and offset to factory defaults (gain = 1.0, offset = 0.0).

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Diagnostics
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Sensor diagnostic and test information for troubleshooting.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Sensor Information
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the software version and driver version installed on the sensor.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Serial Number
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the serial number of the sensor.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Gain Correction
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Adjusts the calibration gain (slope) value within the range 0.50 to 1.5.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Offset Correction
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Adjusts the calibration offset value within the range –3.00 to +3.00.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Phase Diagnostics
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the phase for total, red and blue wavelengths; updates once per second.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Amplitude Diagnostics
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the amplitude for red and blue wavelengths; updates once per second.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Days Remaining to Clean
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the number of days until the next scheduled manual cleaning.

ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.label: Sensor Life
ldo_sc_model2@1.29/device_menu.diagnosti.description: Shows the number of days until the next scheduled sensor cap replacement.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.label: Configure
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.description: Select a sensor name and type of sensor; change options for measurement, calibration, data handling and storage.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.name.label: Name
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.name.description: Changes the name displayed at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 12 characters (letters, numbers, spaces or punctuation).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.label: Select sensor
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.description: Selects the type of sensor (pH or ORP).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.format.label: Format
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.format.description: For pH sensors only—changes the number of decimal places shown on the measurement screen to XX.XX (default) or XX.X.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.label: Temperature
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.data_lo.label: Data logger interval
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.data_lo.description: Sets the time interval for data storage in the data log—Disabled, 5, 10, 15, 30 seconds, 1, 5, 10, 15 (default), 30 minutes, 1, 2, 6, 12 hours.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.ac_freq.label: Alternating current frequency
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.ac_freq.description: Selects the frequency of the AC power supplied to the controller (50 or 60 Hz).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.filter.label: Filter
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.filter.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 60 seconds) to calculate an average value and increase signal stability; 0 = no effect (default).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.label: Temperature element
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.tempera.description: pH sensors—sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT100, PT1000, NTC300 (default) or Manual; ORP sensors—a temperature element can be connected to measure temperature only.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.label: Select standard buffer
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.select_.description: For pH sensors only—selects the buffer solutions used for calibration: pH 4, 7, 10 (default) or DIN 19267.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.pure_h2.label: Pure H2O compensation
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.pure_h2.description: For pH sensors only—adds a temperature-dependent correction for pure water with additives: None (default), Ammonia, Morpholine, Pure water, User defined, or 1–4-point matrix correction.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.last_ca.label: Last calibration
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.last_ca.description: Sets a reminder interval (default: 60 days) for the next calibration; a reminder appears on the display after the selected number of days from the last calibration date.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.sensor_.label: Sensor days
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.sensor_.description: Sets the sensor replacement interval (default: 365 days); a warning appears when the sensor has been in operation longer than this interval.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.impedan.label: Impedance limits
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.impedan.description: Sets the low (default: 0 MΩ) and high (default: 1000 MΩ) impedance limits for the active and reference electrodes.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.reset_s.label: Reset setup
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.configure.reset_s.description: Sets all sensor settings back to factory defaults and resets counters; all device information is lost.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 1-point auto correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses one buffer (e.g., pH 7); the sensor automatically identifies the buffer during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 2-point auto correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses two buffers (e.g., pH 7 and pH 4); the sensor automatically identifies the buffers during calibration (recommended).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 1-point manual correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses a sample of known pH value or one buffer; the user enters the pH value during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.label: 2-point manual correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.ph_cali.description: Uses two samples of known pH value or two buffers; the user enters the pH values during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.orp_cal.label: 1-point manual correction
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.orp_cal.description: Calibrates the ORP sensor against one reference solution or sample of known value; the user enters the ORP value during calibration.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.tempera.label: Temperature adjustment
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.tempera.description: Calibrates the temperature reading against an accurate external thermometer by entering the exact measured temperature value.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.label: Cancel
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.description: Stops the calibration; a new calibration must start from the beginning.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.label: Exit
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.exit_ca.description: Exits the calibration temporarily; access to other menus is allowed and a calibration for a second sensor (if present) can be started.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.factory.label: Reset setup
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.calibrate.factory.description: Sets the sensor back to the factory calibration values.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.description: Access sensor diagnostic information and test readings.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.senso.label: Sensor information
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.senso.description: Shows the sensor type, name, serial number, software version and driver version.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.calib.label: Calibration history
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.calib.description: Shows the pH slope (mV/pH) and date of the last calibration; the pH slope should be 55 to 61 mV/pH.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Sensor signal
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: Shows the sensor reading in mV; the mV range is –60 to +60 mV (0 mV = pH 7).

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Measurement analog to digital converter counter
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: Shows the digital number that represents the pH or ORP reading.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Temperature analog to digital converter counter
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: Shows the digital number that represents the temperature reading.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.label: Impedance status
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.signa.description: When set to Enabled (recommended), measures active and reference electrode impedance at 1-minute intervals and shows an error when impedance is outside the configured limits.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.label: Sensor days
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.label: Reset
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.description: Sets the Sensor days and Electrode days values to zero.

phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.label: Electrode days
phd_sc@Any/device_menu.diagnostics.count.description: Shows the number of days since the salt bridge was replaced; automatically reset to zero when the salt bridge is replaced.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.label: Sensor Setup
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.description: Configure and operate the SOLITAX sc sensor via the sc controller.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.label: Configure
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.description: Select measurement parameter, units, intervals and defaults for the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.ed.label: Edit Name
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.ed.description: Enter up to a 10-character sensor name using any combination of symbols and alphanumeric characters; default is the sensor serial number.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Set Parameter
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Configures the sensor to measure turbidity (TRB) or suspended solids (TS); the sensor cannot measure both simultaneously.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.me.label: Meas Units
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.me.description: Selects the measurement units: TRB — FNU (default), EBC, TE/F, NTU; TS — mg/L, g/L, ppm, %.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.cl.label: Clean Interval
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.cl.description: Sets the interval between automated wiper cleaning cycles — 1, 5, 15, or 30 minutes; 1, 4, or 12 hours; 1, 3, or 7 days (default: 12 hours).

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.re.label: Response Time
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.re.description: Sets the damping/averaging period for displayed readings, 4–20 outputs, and alarm updates — 0 to 300 seconds (default: 3 seconds).

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.lo.label: Logger Interval
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.lo.description: Sets the data log storage interval — 1 to 15 minutes (default: 10 minutes); logged values are the average of all readings during the previous interval.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.label: Set Defaults
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.configure.se.description: Resets all user-editable options to factory default settings.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.label: Set Outmode
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.description: Selects the behavior of the 4–20 mA outputs and alarm relays during calibration — Active, Hold, or Transfer.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.label: Sensor Measure
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.se.description: Displays the current, uncorrected measured value from the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.of.label: Offset
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.of.description: Sets the turbidity zero-point offset value, calculated from a deionized water reading during turbidity calibration.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.fa.label: Factor
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.fa.description: Enters the single-point calibration factor for turbidity or suspended solids, calculated from a known standard or gravimetric reference value.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: Factor
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Single-point calibration; calculates a new factor from one grab sample and the sensor reading at that moment.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 2 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Two-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 3 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Three-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 4 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Four-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: 5 Points
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Five-point suspended solids calibration; enter pairs of sensor readings and laboratory-determined values in ascending order.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.label: Set Cal Default
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.calibrate.ca.description: Returns the sensor to factory default calibration settings.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.label: Test/Maint
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.description: Access diagnostic information and maintenance functions for the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.w.label: Wipe
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.w.description: Initiates an immediate wiping action on the sensor optical window.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.s.label: Signals
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.s.description: Displays the current signal outputs for the sensor.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.o.label: Output Mode
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.o.description: Selects the behavior of the instrument outputs during test/maintenance — Hold, Active, Transfer, or Selection.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.d.label: Default Setup
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.d.description: Resets all user-editable options to factory defaults.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.label: Probe Info
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.description: Displays the sensor type, sensor name, serial number, software version number, and sensor driver version number.

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.label: Profile Counter
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.description: Displays the number of wiper cycles remaining (counts down from 20,000).

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.label: Reset Config
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.p.description: Manually resets the wiper profile counter; confirm with MAN. RESET ARE YOU SURE?

solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.c.label: Counter
solitax_sc@All/sensor_setup.test_maint.c.description: Shows the number of hours or cycles remaining for operating hours, test/maintenance interval, gasket, and motor.
